checks.name: a busy application gate refuses backup without producing a partial output
full database, owned objects and recovery keys are encrypted and integrity checked
remote operator control and PostgreSQL tool connections reject weaker TLS before database access
wrong keys and modified encrypted archives fail before any database creation
path traversal and symlink archive entries are rejected before extraction
authenticated pg_restore recreates complete business rows and tenant quotas on a second instance
restore refuses existing databases, existing object directories and source repository key export
restored native SaaS starts with verified RLS and preserves owner and cross-tenant boundaries
restored encrypted merchant credentials and recovery operation settle once through the native provider
restored signed jobs resume with the original tenant identity
restored media bytes match the recorded database digest
